messages:
julia_support: heads up — customer (harry_customer) hitting 404s after upgrading to @redwood/sdk v1.2.0 from v1.1.2. They say the TS client no longer has `stream.chat` or accepts `conversationId`.
harry_customer: SGTM — we upgraded yesterday. Calls to `client.chat.stream({ conversationId })` now return `404 Not Found` (no route). CLI logs: `Error: 404 - route not found: /v1/chat/stream`.
julia_support: repro steps provided by customer: 1) npm i @redwood/sdk@1.2.0 2) run example

```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
await client.chat.stream({ conversationId: 'conv-123', model: 'redwood-small' })
```

response: `{
  "error": "Not Found",
  "message": "route not found: /v1/chat/stream"
}`

They also tried `conversation_id` vs `conversationId` — both fail.
aisha_devex: thanks — can you paste full package.json and the exact SDK import path? sometimes downstream bundlers pull an old artifact. Also which region? harry_customer mentioned eu-west.
harry_customer: package.json: "@redwood/sdk": "1.2.0". Region eu-west-1. Node 18.
matthew_engineer: quick hypothesis: we rolled out a new API surface in 2026-02 that moved chat streaming under `/v1alpha/streams` and renamed `conversationId` -> `chatId` in the new contract. SDK v1.2.0 should have had the updated client, but it looks like the published TS types still reference old routes in the route map. Could be a publish/tag mismatch (npm dist-tag mismatch between code and compiled bundle).
julia_support: can we confirm with a curl from their region? suggested troubleshooting step: raw HTTP call to see server-side behavior.

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"conversationId":"conv-123","model":"redwood-small"}'
```

matthew_engineer: if that returns 404 but `/v1alpha/streams` returns 200 then it's confirmed. Workaround for customers: either pin SDK to 1.1.x or call raw endpoint until we publish a patch. I'll open a hotfix.
bot-ci: CI alert: publish pipeline #2345 succeeded for @redwood/sdk@1.2.1 (tag: next) — see <https://ci.internal/2345>
aisha_devex: ok, likely dist-tag issue — customers installing `1.2.0` might get a mixed artifact. Two short-term options for support: 1) ask customer to `npm i @redwood/sdk@1.1.5` (safest) OR 2) `npm i @redwood/sdk@1.2.1-next` (contains fix) OR 3) use raw fetch to `/v1alpha/streams` with `chatId` param. Example raw call for option 3:

```ts
const res = await fetch('https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1alpha/streams', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ chatId: 'conv-123', model: 'redwood-small' })
})
console.log(await res.text())
```

harry_customer: we can try pinning to 1.1.5 — will do and report back.

(10m later)

harry_customer: pinned to 1.1.5 — streaming works again. thanks.
matthew_engineer: created GH issue and hotfix PR #4567 to re-align dist-tags and republish a proper 1.2.1. I'll add a note to changelog about route renames and migration steps (conversationId -> chatId, /v1/chat/stream -> /v1alpha/streams). ETA for publish: ~1 hour.
aisha_devex: I'll draft a short support KB and a one-liner migration guide for the changelog page. Ping me when 1.2.1 is promoted from `next` to `latest`.
julia_support: closing loop with customer. Thanks all :raised_hands:
